lobbysettings.title: Lobby Settings
lobbysettings.gamehostonly: Only the game host can change this!
lobbysettings.inlobbyonly: You can only change this in the lobby!
lobbysettings.ghost_only_warning: This disables the sound for alive players.
lobbysettings.meetings_only_warning: This disables the sound for alive players outside meetings.
lobbysettings.ghosts_can_talk_ingame_description: Ghosts keep talking during the round and hear each other anywhere on the map, like in a meeting. Living players still cannot hear them.
lobbysettings.grace_period_description: Seconds of voice kept alive after a round starts, so nobody is cut off mid-sentence.
lobbysettings.impostor_radio_private_description: Crewmates nearby cannot hear an impostor while they talk on the radio.

public_lobby.title: Title
public_lobby.enable_warning: Enabling this will make your lobby public to other BetterCrewLink users!
public_lobby.ban_warning: Inappropriate text will result in a ban from BetterCrewLink.

lobbysettings.host_notice: These settings are controlled by the game host.
lobbysettings.host_notice_you: You are the host, so the lobby uses your own settings.
lobbysettings.no_lobby: Not connected to a lobby yet. Join or host a game to see the settings in effect.
lobbysettings.mine_notice: These apply to everyone in the lobby while you are the host.

players.title: Players
players.empty: No other players right now. Join a lobby to adjust their volume.

audio.title: Audio
audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.microphone_sens_warning: If you set the sensitivity any lower it might not work.
audio.auto_gain_disabled: Disabled while Automatic Gain Control is on.

keyboard.title: Hotkeys
keyboard.hint: Click a shortcut, then press a key or mouse button. Press Escape to disable it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.nat_fix_warning: This will FIX the NAT issues but will add a delay since it is using a server instead of Peer to Peer (P2P).
advanced.voice_server_warning: This option is for advanced users only. Other servers can steal your info or crash BetterCrewLink.

beta.title: BETA/DEBUG
beta.hardware_acceleration_warning: This disables Hardware Acceleration (which can increase CPU usage)
beta.echocancellation_description: Always off in the microphone test above, so use headphones while monitoring.
beta.autoGainControl_warning: This is a beta feature. It lets your microphone driver automatically adjust volume. Use the Test Microphone button to check how it sounds.
beta.oldsampledebug_warning: This is a test function ONLY enabled when asked.

streaming.title: Streaming Settings
streaming.voice_server_comp_warning: It is recommended to just change the voice server to a BetterCrewLink Voice Server (https://bettercrewl.ink) for example.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.restore_warning: This will reset ALL settings to their default values.
troubleshooting.warning: Not available as host in game!

toumira.title: Town of Us: Mira
toumira.bridge_connected: TOU-Mira bridge connected. Role effects below are applied to voice chat.
toumira.bridge_missing: TOU-Mira bridge not detected. Install TouMiraBclBridge.dll in your Among Us BepInEx/plugins folder next to Town of Us Mira, then start the game. Until then these rules have no effect.
toumira.host_controls: These rules are set by the lobby host.
toumira.requires_parent: Turn on the rule above first.
toumira.touMira_enabled: Apply Town of Us: Mira voice rules
toumira.touMira_enabled_description: Master switch for every rule on this page.
toumira.touMira_muteBlackmailedInMeetings_descri: The blackmailed player cannot be heard during the meeting.
toumira.touMira_muteBlackmailedNextRound: Keep blackmailed player muted next round
toumira.touMira_muteBlackmailedNextRound_descrip: The player stays muted during the task round after the meeting they were blackmailed in.
toumira.touMira_muteJailedInMeetings_description: The jailed player cannot be heard during the meeting.
toumira.touMira_jailPersistsAfterJailorDeath: Jail mute persists if Jailor dies
toumira.touMira_jailPersistsAfterJailorDeath_des: Keep the jailed player muted even when the Jailor is dead.
toumira.touMira_mutePuppeteerControlled_descript: A player being controlled by the Puppeteer cannot be heard.
toumira.touMira_puppeteerHearFromVictim_descript: While controlling someone, the Puppeteer hears from the victim's position instead of their own.
toumira.touMira_muteParasiteControlled_descripti: A player being controlled by the Parasite cannot be heard.
toumira.touMira_parasiteHearFromVictim_descripti: The Parasite hears both around itself and around its victim.
toumira.touMira_muteSwooped_description: An invisible Swooper cannot be heard until the swoop ends.
toumira.touMira_muteGlitchHacked_description: A player hacked by the Glitch cannot be heard until the hack ends.
toumira.touMira_muffleBlinded: Muffle hearing when blinded or flashed
toumira.touMira_muffleBlinded_description: Players blinded by the Eclipsal or flashed by the Grenadier hear everyone muffled.
toumira.touMira_muffleHysteria_description: Hypnotized players hear everyone muffled while the Hypnotist's Mass Hysteria is active.

muted.blackmailed: You are blackmailed. Nobody can hear you.
muted.jailed: You are jailed. Nobody can hear you.
muted.puppeteer: You are being controlled by the Puppeteer. Nobody can hear you.
muted.parasite: You are being controlled by the Parasite. Nobody can hear you.
muted.swooped: You are swooped. Nobody can hear you until you reappear.
muted.hacked: You are hacked by the Glitch. Nobody can hear you.
